layouts.name: Prescott Hill Climb
layouts.description: Draft configuration: Open long hillclimb retains the central hairpin and full climbing branch, excluding the shorter bypass and return spur. The operator describes a 1,127-yard course (about 1,030.6 m), consistent with the independent 1,033.1 m timed source path. The catalogue scalar 1,222 m differs; geometry is neither extended nor scaled. Separate endpoint nodes agree with private timing gates. Branch identity was checked against catalogue layout facts and circuit identification references. Independent source distance 1033.1 m; no coordinates are changed to match a diagram or distance. Travel direction and historical alignment remain provisional.
